hypotheses.statement: The incident was caused by an expired certificate on payments-gateway.internal, not by release 2026.5.14-a
The temporal proximity of the release (09:09:52Z) and certificate expiration (09:11:40Z) led to incorrect attribution

observed_facts.statement: Release 2026.5.14-a contained only email template changes and a CSV export library dependency bump
No code path in release 2026.5.14-a is reachable from POST /v2/checkout/submit
TLS handshake failures began at 09:11:47Z with error 'certificate verify failed: certificate has expired'
The payments-gateway.internal leaf certificate expired at 09:11:40Z
Error ratio returned to baseline (0.004) at 09:58:10Z
The rollback completed at 10:04:18Z, after recovery
Sampled trace shows no span entered email template or CSV export code paths

open_questions.missing_evidence: Documentation or runbook identifying certificate renewal ownership
open_questions.question: Who owns the renewal automation for the payments-gateway.internal certificate?

open_questions.missing_evidence: Impact assessment in INC-7742 or incident channel
open_questions.question: What was the customer impact estimate during the incident?

summary: A spike in 5xx errors and latency for checkout submit was caused by an expired certificate on payments-gateway.internal, not by the coincidentally timed release 2026.5.14-a. The certificate expired at 09:11:40Z, causing TLS handshake failures starting at 09:11:47Z. Recovery occurred after certificate rotation at 09:57:50Z. An unnecessary rollback was performed after recovery.

timeline.statement: payments connector begins experiencing TLS handshake failures due to expired certificate at payments-gateway.internal:8443
checkout submit requests start returning 502 upstream_unavailable after payments connector retries exhausted
alert fires for checkout-api error ratio above objective (0.184 vs 0.005) on POST /v2/checkout/submit
alert fires for checkout-api latency objective burn with p99 latency rising to 10400ms (client timeout) on POST /v2/checkout/submit
sampled trace shows payments.authorize span timing out after 10388ms with no upstream response
payments connector TLS handshakes succeed again after certificate rotation takes effect
checkout-api rolled back to 2026.5.13-c, six minutes after error ratio returned to baseline
